The '''incinerator war droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stood several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was armed with a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] and [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas tank along with a large [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shield]]. The droids were an advancement of the [[carbonite war droid]], but they were developed to house a flamethrower in their "arm" instead of a [[carbonite projector]].<ref name="TFUII" />

==History==
[[File:Starkiller_Incinerator_War_Droid.png|thumb|left|200px|An incinerator war droid attacking [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]].]]

By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the war droids had been developed.<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the game have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref> The project held the record for most industrial accidents and most casualties. The defector [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kamer Suu]] spoke about them.<ref name="TFUII" />

A [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] encountered several incinerator war droids on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Some of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] also joined the invading [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B Frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] above Kamino, some of which also being used to fry the communications equipment onboard the ''Salvation'' before the clone destroyed them in an attempt to re-establish the communications with the Rebellion.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Incinerator war droids first appeared in the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="TFUII" />
